question: Which outcome and whole-service guarantees follow from verified-WIN substitution?
assumptions: Same exact full rule/history and named acting seat.
Finite scored zero-sum WDL game, legal returned root actions; neutral/non-scoring Session outcomes excluded from numeric comparisons.
WIN certificate independently verified for the acting seat; action selected from its root OR edge, with protocol cancellation/deadline/dispatch status separately qualified.

replacement.weak_guarantee: Nonnegative root-action minimax gain against ANY legal baseline action at that SAME context on a successfully verified/adopted WIN slot.
replacement.strict_condition: U_B<1; rootWIN or changed action alone does not establish it.
replacement.not_game_strength: Actual future policy must follow a valid strategy and meet continuation service; root-action value is not an observed terminal win.

baseline_first.on_proof_success: Replace retained legal prefix action by verified WIN action.
baseline_first.guarantee: Never worse in minimax root-action value than THAT retained prefix action.
baseline_first.not_guaranteed: No domination of a separately run full-service alpha-beta baseline. Time reserved for proof can change what uniform iterations complete; deeper search is not assumed monotone in actual quality.

proof_first.existing: Current research chooser first allocates proof, then verification and fallback.
proof_first.failure_case: Fallback may receive less time/nodes; no retained full-budget baseline action is available.
proof_first.judgment: A proof success is safe as a root-action choice; a solve-or-fallback policy as a whole still needs matched full-service comparison.

finite_panel.F: remaining/failed/censored slots; retain in fixed denominator
finite_panel.meaning: This is a deterministic partial-information bound, not a probability/p-value or assumed natural visitation law.
finite_panel.success_only: Without baseline action upper bounds below1, verified successes have zero guaranteed positive margin. Dropping unsuccessful/censored slots is not allowed.
finite_panel.missing_choice_scope: For a missing/unreturned action, the interval ranges over possible legal completions of that planned slot; no actual action or WDL is imputed. If the protocol defines a failure penalty, that is a different explicit metric.

continuation: A root WIN certificate gives a decreasing-rank strategy, not a guarantee that an arbitrary later controller follows it.
SessionStrategyCursor binds exact state/record and observes already committed edges. Unexpected own actions invalidate continuation; arbitrary legal opponent defenses must all be covered.
Per-turn admission/time/cancel failure can censor actual play despite a logically valid root certificate. Record selected, dispatched, committed and actual rule-terminal outcomes separately.
commit_session_decision has one physical execute, then observer checks may execute hypothetical copies. Do not count these as multiple played moves or omit their whole-game execution cost.
claim_type: Analytic decision bound, no empirical success-rate or transfer claim.
